prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1224; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was struck from behind by a third-party vehicle. Police report requested. Claimant reports pain in the right knee and has been transported to urgent care. Liability appears clear pending statements.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from insured. Insured states they were stopped at a red light when impact occurred. No prior damage noted on the insured vehicle. Photos of rear bumper and trunk area uploaded to file.

Entry 3: Claimant is represented by counsel. All further contact to be routed through the attorney's office. Letter of representation received and logged. Medical authorization forms requested from counsel.

Entry 4: Treating physician records received. Diagnosis includes a knee sprain with swelling, and an MRI has been ordered to rule out ligament damage. Claimant's attorney has submitted a demand package, which is under review. Medical bill reconciliation in progress.

Entry 5: Adjuster reviewed the demand and the medical records with the file supervisor. Independent medical review requested to assess the knee injury and its relationship to the collision. Reserve reviewed and updated. Follow-up with counsel scheduled for next week.
